summary: offline workout, offline intervals, and offline strength all read a "workout_details" family (see internal/cli/offline.go). GET /api/workout/{workout_id} is the shared source for it -- workouts_show.go and promoted_strength.go both hit that exact endpoint (same payload, different displayed fields) but each writes its own generic write-through under its own resourceType ("workouts", "strength"), never "workout_details". Any future regen must keep cacheWorkoutDetail (data_source.go) wired into both call sites' live-fetch success path -- dropping either one silently breaks the corresponding offline command for every workout, not just some.
reason: Discovered while writing SKILL.md/README.md documentation for the offline command family (this session): all three of offline workout/intervals/strength returned "stored workout_details fact ... not found" for every workout unconditionally, because nothing anywhere had ever written to that family under that exact name -- confirmed by grep before this patch. Since the docs were about to actively advertise these commands as working, shipping them permanently broken was worse than not documenting them at all.
validated_outcome: Verified live against a real account: `workouts show <id>` followed by `offline workout <id>`, `offline intervals <id>`, and `strength <id>` followed by `offline strength <id>` all now return real data instead of a not-found error (intervals/strength correctly report a caveat rather than an error for workout types that genuinely lack a class identifier or movement-tracker data). offline.go's newOfflineWorkoutCmd/newOfflineIntervalsCmd were also changed to build their cobra.Command directly (Use as a literal) instead of routing through the shared offlineIDCmd factory -- unrelated to this fix's runtime behavior (confirmed identical via full test suite), but required for verify-skill's static Use: scan to resolve the SKILL.md/README.md references this session added; the factory pattern hid the Use string as a function argument, invisible to a checker that only reads literal `Use: "..."` text. TestWorkoutsShowLiveFetchPopulatesWorkoutDetails and TestStrengthLiveFetchPopulatesWorkoutDetails added. Full go build/vet/test suite, govulncheck, and verify_skill.py all pass.
